notes: Malicious XLL loaded into Microsoft-signed EXCEL.EXE (Program Files) reads the WAM token cache and posts it to a raw IP. wam_client_reader makes the read Low Audit and ST-04 Audit-only for *any* destination (unlike the per-user allowance, which is destination-bound).
known_gap: wam_client_reader (Program Files Microsoft-signed app) makes ST-04 Low Audit for any destination; an XLL loaded into Excel is not a tamper signal
